title: Emperor Augustus (Imperator Caesar Divi Filius)
biography: First Roman Emperor who transformed Rome from a city of brick into a city of marble, establishing the 200-year Pax Romana, the Praetorian Guard, and administrative civil governance.
internationalConnections: Expanded Roman borders to the Danube and Rhine, secured peace treaties with Parthian King Phraates IV, and established diplomatic envoys with India.
